description: Same root cause as F-NA-1-1: with logos unavailable, Google Calendar, Google Drive and GitHub all show the letter 'G' on the Integrations tiles, so the tile logos cannot tell the apps apart; the story's check 'three different logos' fails in this environment. Not verified with real logos.
expected: Three different logos in the pill, each once; same image as the tile.
actual: Before Slack was connected the pill showed 'G, G, S' (see STORY-NA-2 step-0.png); step-1.png was taken after NA-4 connected Slack, so it shows 'G, G, N'. Integrations tiles show G (Calendar), G (Drive), S (Slack) in STORY-NA-2 step-2.png. Slack appears once in Popular (before I connected it) and the pill shows it once.
